http_version
Description
Specifies the HTTP protocol version. Possible values are “HTTP/1.0” or
“HTTP/1.1”. This is a BIG-IP version 4.X variable, provided for
backward compatibility. You can use the equivalent 9.X command,
HTTP::version
instead.
Syntax
http_version
http_version
Specifies the HTTP protocol version.
